reference under external/dolphin-dsp-reference. Exact imported source hashes
are recorded in SOURCE-HASHES.json; no upstream Git revision is claimed here.
Upstream project: https://github.com/dolphin-emu/dolphin
Upstream paths: Source/Core/Core/HW/DSPHLE/UCodes/Zelda.cpp and Zelda.h

GPL-2.0.txt contains GNU GPL version2, obtained from
https://www.gnu.org/licenses/old-licenses/gpl-2.0.txt . The original per-file
GPL-2.0-or-later designation and upstream COPYING notice are retained.
The generated Native/ZeldaAudioRenderer.hpp and generated/ZeldaAudioRenderer.cpp
and Native/DspAudioFrameExecutor.hpp/src/dsp_audio_frame_executor.cpp (sequencing
adapted from ZeldaUCode::RenderAudio) are derivatives under GPL-2.0-or-later.
Distribute their corresponding source,
these upstream sources, adaptation generator and required license notices with
redistributed builds that use this renderer.

Native adaptations are explicit in generate-zelda-audio-renderer.ps1:
- Extract only the renderer/voice state and its flags; omit Dolphin's system,
  mail protocol and emulator save-state dependencies.
- Replace emulator memory access with registered, bounded DSP wire-memory access.
- Keep the sample synthesis, AFC decoding, resampling, mixing and filters.
- Replace two BitField reads with equivalent explicit masks.
- Enable upstream strict diagnostics and throw on unsupported operations;
  reject invalid voice indices, zero-size active reverb and invalid output spans.

This is an isolated native renderer component, not an integrated game audio
backend. Existing upstream limitations remain, including variable FIR filtering
and incomplete back-channel/Dolby postmix details. The port must not call unknown
features successful or claim hardware-perfect output without comparison.
Do not pass little-endian native JAS records directly as DSP wire memory; use
DspVoiceWire's explicit translation. Reverb native-pointer layout integration,
native scheduling/mailbox delivery, completion interrupts and Windows output
integration remain separate required work. DspNativeAudioBridge now provides
explicit native scalar/pointer/ring/output conversion in a standalone tested
component. It is not connected to the production game backend.

SMG reverb/window corrections are maintained in dsp_smg_reverb.inc and the
adaptation generator, based on the exact D643001F jdsp instruction image:
four 8-history/80-live-sample DRAM windows, distinct base/base+8 views, frame
history/clearing, downloaded-block0x7FFF gain and ring write-back. The original
SEND_TABLE0xDC8/0xE28/0xE88/0xEE8 destinations now resolve to their actual live
offsets. A uCode-anchored absolute-DRAM fixture covers all four, signed feedback
and pre/post/both/no reverb FIR. This is not a complete LLE/hardware-fidelity
verification; voice FIR, Dolby/back postmix and production scheduling remain open.
